text: A bald, muscular male figure with a round face and heavy brow. He wears a sleeveless red tunic over dark pants, accessorized with gold bracelets on his right wrist. His left hand rests near his chin as he gazes outward through an arched opening at a starry night sky. The scene is framed by deep red curtains. Behind him, partially obscured, are curved stone structures. He appears contemplative or observant, standing still in profile.
